title: refactor: click styling-> rich
description:
Replace in shell.py and virtualenv.py.
Also, replace in some exceptions.

This is continuing my previous work in attempt to remove click in favor of rich.


@aidencullo

review_comments.author: aidencullo
review_comments.body: i think this show function is unreachable, were you able to hit it?

review_comments.author: oz123
review_comments.body: I have not seen an exception raised with extra in the code. But we might just want to leave it, as it should be used.
